title: Will thunderbird still work when microsoft discontinues EWS
creator: aaron9
content:
Just got an email from GoDaddy, my domain provider, about Microsoft discontinuing Their Exchange Web Service. My wife uses the web service but I use Thunderbird. Will Thunderbird still work for Exchange email or do I have to submit to Microsoft's extortion and use Office 365?

This is the message I got:

Microsoft will be ending Exchange Web Services (EWS) in the next few months. Your email service is not ending. We're contacting you because your account shows you may be using EWS. If you use a current, supported Microsoft application, keeping it up to date should be the only action you need to take. If you use another email, calendar or backup application, or your organization manages its own connection to Microsoft 365, please review our help article to check whether further action is required. 

The deprecation of EWS is currently scheduled to begin in October 2026 and be completed by April 2027.
